items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: my mother took a piece of rag and took a needle

ctx.x: I was going to ask a little bit more, if you have time, about the slow drag. Did you dance that with just one girl, or did you go around in a circle?

One girl, one girl, see, everybody got to have a couple, I mean a couple, see. Just like you would have a lady, you would have a lady with your dancing. And the one with the dance that slow drag the bass, we won the prize. You know, that's when my prize got soon. He used to be a good dancer too. We had a ball called 88, he wanted to throw around and show me that he beat me dancing. I was working painting, I stuck a piece of pine wood in my foot, it must have been about two weeks.
